title: Teach AI Your Writing Style
description: Create a system prompt that captures your personal writing style so AI produces text that sounds like you, not like generic AI.
steps: Collect 5 samples of your best writing (emails, posts, documents)
Ask AI: "Analyze the writing style in these samples and describe it in detail: sentence length, vocabulary level, tone, structure, and distinctive patterns"
Use that analysis to write a system prompt that instructs AI to match your style
Test it by asking AI to draft a new email or post in your style
Refine the system prompt based on where the style misses
expectedOutput: A personal writing style system prompt and 3 examples of AI-generated content that sound authentically like you.
bonusChallenges: Save this as a Custom GPT for instant access
Try giving the same style prompt to two different models and compare
